name: dsh-turn-sieve
description: Turn Sieve · 回合筛 — prune low-value parts of a DeepSeek Harness chat in place: sieve a whole exchange, only your prompt, only the reply, a single message, or in-turn notice cards (stopped / failed / retried / compacted); ✓ confirms, ✕ cancels, no dialog, and one undo restores it. 1.3.0 makes the sieve button appear on every message and notice card that renders later, and gives it its own row under the bubble so it never covers the message text. 1.3.1 fixes a build-stamp string the market's trust scanner misread as an IP address; behaviour is unchanged. 1.4.0 stops injected context rows from splitting an exchange, so the Exchange scope covers the prompt and the reply together again, and anchors the preview region to the transcript so it follows its rows instead of drifting on scroll. 在对话里原位筛除低价值问答或单条消息，✓ 确认 ✕ 取消、全程不弹窗，可随时撤销；1.3.0 修好了后渲染的消息与提示卡片没有「筛除」按钮、以及按钮压住正文的问题；1.3.1 只把会被误读为 IP 的构建戳改掉，运行时行为与 1.3.0 相同。1.4.0 修好了注入上下文把一轮对话拆散、导致「整段」只筛掉提问的问题，并让预览阴影固定在对话滚动容器里、跟着内容走而不是向上漂。

scripts.test: node test/sieve.test.mjs && node test/docs.test.mjs && node test/client-load.mjs
